A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the adjustment of the basic age–height equation for uneven-aged black stands is possible and that the best index to use is the Shannon index of diversity.
the age–height equation that included a modifier based on the ESh index performed well and was able to account for the effects of stand structure on dominant height.
the use of a site index (SI) to predict dominant height in uneven-aged black spruces stands should be avoided.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a site index modifier in the age–height equation for uneven-aged stands is not only justified, but also necessary to accurately predict dominant height of black spruce stands in Quebec.
